Each app release is its own prerelease tag that never becomes Latest; OTA Latest is preserved, never moved. preserveLatest is the public Beta frankel-2026102901, pixel-ota Latest as confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-30 (AGENT311-APP-ONLY: the 311 publisher refused under 2806 in run 41076632464 because Latest had moved; nothing was published). It is one exact tag compared before and after publication, never a floating or newest-wins rule. Before 2806 it was frankel-2026102805 from 18:34:04 UTC (rose-agent-306 and rose-agent-307 were published under it) and frankel-2026102804 before that (rose-agent-304). AGENT-BETA-AUTO: the fixed preserveLatest tag (frankel-2026102901) went stale once the Beta advanced (Latest 2026103014 and later), so every app publication would refuse. The publisher now preserves whatever OS release is Latest: Latest must be a latestTagPattern OS release before publication and still an OS release of the same or a newer build after it; an app prerelease, no Latest or a move back is refused, and an app release is never made Latest

permissionApex.basis: INFRA-HOME-098: OS #70 patches packages/modules/Permission 4d6005db RoleService (os/patches/rose-home-role-permission.patch) and ships in the com.android.permission APEX. The gate reads the target-files: exactly this module (no Google prebuilt), apex_manifest version from the pinned RELEASE_DEFAULT_UPDATABLE_MODULE_VERSION (cur -> cp2a), the patch's setting and package constants in service-permission.jar, the payload AVB signature, and the payload key: the module's own key unsigned, avb.pem (avbPublicKeySha256) signed, with the container signed by releasekey (otaCertificateSha256), as generate-release.sh maps it. Derivations: scripts/tests/fixtures/permission-apex/README.md. Artifact inclusion only; selected HOME, boot and migration are runtime evidence

systemUiTray.basis: INFRA-CANDIDATE-115: the Agent tray overlays (os/overlays/frameworks/base/libs/WindowManager/Shell/src/com/android/wm/shell, OS #85 adds AgentTrayLink and changes AgentTrayPrototype) are only copied into frameworks/base; the gate reads the SystemUI APK's dex in the target-files and the system_ext image bytes. Pinned frameworks/base 84183aff: wm_shell-sources globs src/**/*.java into WindowManager-Shell, a static library of SystemUI (system_ext_specific, privileged); SystemUI's proguard keeps com.android.wm.shell.* class names and strips only verbose logs, so the class descriptors and the new Log.w literal survive. The last two markers exist only with OS #85; a 2805-shaped SystemUI has only the first two. Derivations: scripts/tests/fixtures/systemui-84183aff/README.md. Code inclusion only; screen-off/resume behavior is runtime evidence

roseEdge.basis: OS Product's #410 1C/2A artifact checklist item 4 and its R8-literal checker (2026-11-05), run by bytes-verify and ota-verify through scripts/edge_artifact.py, which reads the dex itself (no dexdump on the builder). Props: PRODUCT_SYSTEM_PROPERTIES of rose-edge-build-make.patch and agent-tray-build-make.patch, both registered by --agent-tray, so SYSTEM/build.prop. Classes: RoseEdgeGesture and RoseEdgeSwipe (os/overlays/packages/apps/Launcher3/quickstep/src/com/android/quickstep/fallback) in Launcher3QuickStep, class only: at pinned Launcher3 47accce its R8 rules (-keep,allowshrinking,allowoptimization and -keepclasseswithmembernames on com.android.quickstep.**, no allowobfuscation) keep class names but may inline and remove single-call-site members such as stage and onMove (OS Product's review of #568); RoseEdgeController (com.android.wm.shell.roseedge) and RoseEdgeMicSlot (com.android.wm.shell) of rose-edge-wmshell.patch in SystemUI, whose static library WindowManager-Shell is. SystemUI's R8 keeps com.android.wm.shell.* class names but not subpackages, so a class may also pass on a whole string literal only its code holds: RoseEdgeSwipe's diagnostics switch, the IRoseEdge binder descriptor (a compile-time constant of the generated interface) and the mic slot's log tag. RoseEdgeGesture has none, so a rename fails closed. Literals, required as well and not a fallback: persist.wm.debug.rose_edge_diag in Launcher3QuickStep's dex is #548's artifact proof (the two classes predate it): #548 (6d2ee72) added it as RoseEdgeSwipe.DIAG_PROPERTY, a compile-time constant that javac inlines into SystemProperties.getBoolean in RoseEdgeSwipe's constructor, which FallbackSwipeHandler's constructor reaches (rose-edge-launcher3.patch), so R8 cannot drop it while the gesture is linked (OS Product, 2026-11-05). Code inclusion only; behaviour is device evidence
